verdict.rationale: telli offers a bearer-token REST API with a published OpenAPI spec for managing contacts, scheduling calls and importing SIP phone numbers, plus webhooks for call events. Its MCP server exposes Charlie, the AI assistant that builds agents, automates workflows and analyzes calls, which gives a programmatic route into more of the UI's functionality. However, the API is described only in terms of contacts, call scheduling and integrations, and many UI features have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: evidence of API/UI parity for agent building, workflow configuration, voice cloning, test calls, live monitoring, analytics dashboards and data-retention settings; an explicit parity statement; independent corroboration.
